cover_headline: Sarvam Launches Dictate API for English and 22 Indian Languages at ₹0.50 a Minute
facts: Dictate turns speech into edited, ready-to-send text in English and 22 Indian languages at ₹0.50 per minute of audio
In Sarvam's own tests, Dictate needed 40% fewer character edits than Google's Gemini 3.5 Transcribe on short English dictations
The API accepts up to 1,000 custom names and terms per request and handles live dictation plus recordings of up to an hour

end.headline: Sarvam Launches Dictate API for English and 22 Indian Languages at ₹0.50 a Minute
end.line: The Bengaluru startup's new developer tool pairs its Saaras v4 speech model with a dictation-tuned Sarvam 105B to turn speech into edited text in one call.
